listType.title: List type
listType.description: "Avis" = today's live calls for tender across every region (~450 at a time). "Dossiers" = the searchable multi-year archive (2015-present) by year. "Contrats" = awarded contracts for a given year, with supplier name, tax ID, declared beneficial owner, and contract amount.
enumTitles: Avis (live calls for tender, all regions)

year.title: Year (dossiers/contrats only)
year.description: Which year to search. Ignored for listType=avis (always the live listing). Dossiers cover 2015-present; contrats cover 2015-present. Requesting an older/full year can return a very large result -- narrow with maxResults if you only need a sample.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are kept in the output for this run. The underlying page/query for the requested year is always fetched in full first (there is no server-side pagination), so this only trims what gets saved to the dataset, not how much is downloaded.
